_comment: AI provider credentials, managed from the Credentials page. One entry per service or relay; Dev Setup reads these when pointing a device's AI tools (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini) at an endpoint. The keys themselves are sealed in the vault beside this file and never leave the gateway except into the config files Dev Setup writes on machines you own.
_comment_fields: kind is anthropic | openai | gemini | custom. base_url empty means the service's default endpoint; set it for relays or self-hosted gateways. id is assigned by the panel. secret_id names the vault.json api_token object holding the key, and is null until one is entered.
